item.tib: rin chen 'phrul mdzod rnga'i brdung thabs
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di blo chung shes ldan bdag bdag gis rjes 'jug dad ldan gang zag dang / dad khom phun tshogs skal ldan bu slob la/ mang pa nyung 'dus don la brtson phyir du/ zab gsal yig ge 'di bkod 'gro sman shog nyes skyon ma sring mkha' 'gro'i gnyen la bshags/ dge ba rgya mtsho'i bdag sogs myur 'grub nas/ 'di mun rnams kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog dben gnas mdzo nyag khrod du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
